hero.body: AllOne Garden is a multiplayer gardening game you can self-host on any device - Raspberry Pi, Mac, Windows PC, Linux server, or Android phone. No central server. No subscriptions. Just community, plants, and good soil.

features.subtitle: Designed from the ground up for community servers - private, fast, and fully under your control.

decentralized.title: Decentralized by design
decentralized.body: Every server is independent. Connect with other gardens through P2P federation.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.body: Your data lives on your own hardware without cloud lock-in.

plugins.title: Plugin system
plugins.body: Extend the game with community plugins - sandboxed and safe.

mobile.title: Mobile ready
mobile.body: Play on iOS and Android as a Progressive Web App.

seasons.title: Real seasons
seasons.body: Weather changes daily and affects strategy and growth.

multiplayer.title: True multiplayer
multiplayer.body: Visit neighbours, trade crops, and help with daily tasks.

preview.subtitle: A clean web UI that feels at home in the browser, on mobile, or on a community kiosk screen.
preview.window_title: AllOne Garden - Alice's Server · 12 players online

federation.subtitle: AllOne Garden servers discover each other over the network without a central registry.

chat.title: Cross-server chat
chat.body: Federated chat messages can be shown with source context.

visits.title: Garden visits
visits.body: Visit gardens on other servers and help with crops.

optin.title: Opt-in only
optin.body: Federation remains optional and under server-owner control.

start.heading: Your first harvest
items: Pick **Till** ⛏️ and tap a plot in your garden.
Pick **Plant** 🌱, choose a seed (radish is fastest!) and tap a plot.
Pick **Water** 💧 and tap your plant.
Press **Next Day** ⏭️. Did it grow? Harvest with **Harvest** 🧺!

start.heading: Next Day
items: Each **Next Day** click makes your plants grow.
Watering helps your plant grow extra.
Bugs on a plant? Use **Spray** 🧴.

start.heading: Coins and XP
items: Harvesting gives coins 🪙 and stars (XP) ⭐.
Spend coins on things in the village.
More XP means a higher level!

plants.heading: How long does it take?
items: 🌸 Radish — 1 day (super fast!)
🥕 Carrot — 2 days · 🥬 Lettuce — 2 days
🍅 Tomato — 3 days · 🥔 Potato — 3 days
🎃 Pumpkin — 5 days (lots of coins!)

plants.heading: Friendly neighbours
items: 💚 Some plants like each other — you get bonus coins.
⚠️ Some combos are not great — watch the faces on your plots.

plants.heading: Weather
items: 🌧️ Rain gives water. ☀️ Drought makes plants thirsty.
⛈️ Storm can hurt crops — a **Greenhouse** 🏡 helps!

garden.heading: ⚠️ Only in YOUR garden!
items: Till, plant and harvest **only** at your home 🏡.
At a neighbour's you may **look**, but **not** build or farm.
Walk to your house on the map to work in your garden.

garden.heading: Building things
items: 🪣 **Water Well** — waters all plots (50 🪙).
🌿 **Compost Heap** — free fertilizer after harvests (30 🪙).
🏡 **Greenhouse** — protects from storms (80 🪙).
Build **only** next to your own garden — nowhere else!

garden.heading: How it works
items: Walk to your garden 🏡 on the map and tap a plot.
Pick a tool and tap **Harvest** 🧺 or **Build** 🔨.
Harvest goes in your basket — sell it for coins.

village.heading: Explore the village
items: On the world map find **Garden Village** 🏘️ — walk there!
Tap a shop, museum or cinema to go inside.
Press **Escape** or ✕ to go back outside.

village.heading: Shops in the village
items: 🔧 **Tool shop** — buy spray and buckets.
🌿 **Fertilizer shop** — food for your plants.
🎬 **Cinema** — watch fun garden videos.
🏛️ **Museum** — learn about plants.
🛒 **Market** — trade with other players.

village.heading: Visiting others
items: Walk to a neighbour 🏡 to see their garden.
You can **help** water 🤝 — that gives XP!
Remember: **you can only build in your own garden.**

village.heading: Chat
items: Talk to other players in 💬 Chat.
Be kind — it's a friendly garden!

tips.heading: Helpful tips
items: 🌸 Start with radish — it's the quickest!
💧 Water before you press **Next Day**.
🏘️ Visit the village when you need supplies.
❓ Ask a grown-up if stuck — or click Help again!

tips.heading: Saving
items: An account saves your garden.
As a **guest** you only play on this device — log in to save.

welcome.title: 👋 Welcome to AllOne Garden!
welcome.body: We'll show you how it works. You can skip anytime. Open Help ❓ later if you need it.

tools.title: 🔧 Tools
tools.body: Pick what to do: till ⛏️, plant 🌱, water 💧 or harvest 🧺. First walk to your home 🏡 on the map!

garden.title: 🌾 Your garden
garden.body: This is the world map. At your house 🏡 tap plots to work. **Only in your own garden** may you till, plant and harvest!

structures.title: 🏗️ Building
structures.body: Spend coins 🪙 on a well, compost or greenhouse. Build **only** next to your own garden — not at neighbours!

village.title: 🏘️ The village
village.body: Walk to Garden Village for shops 🛒, museum 🏛️ and cinema 🎬. Buy supplies or trade at the market.

inventory.title: 🧺 Harvest
inventory.body: Harvested crops land here. Sell for coins 🪙 or trade at the market.

chat.title: 💬 Chat & neighbours
chat.body: Talk to friends. Visit their garden to look — helping is OK, **building is not**.

header.title: ⏭️ Next Day
header.body: See what day it is and press **Next Day** so plants grow! Also find Help ❓ and the world map 🗺️ here.

done.title: 🌱 Ready to play!
done.body: Have fun gardening! Remember: **build only in your own garden.** Click ❓ if you need help.
